title: T-Digit Badge
slide_intent: Define when a contained mark is useful so a symbol can remain visible where the surrounding surface offers little brand color.
strategic_value: A magenta badge can retain T-Mobile color presence in partnerships, merchandise and environmental applications.
demonstration: A square badge is compared with a limited-use badge-and-name lockup across white, magenta and black backgrounds.
practical_value: Choose the badge for a need for contained magenta presence and consult the brand team before using the name lockup.

content_islands.spec: Show the limited-use text lockup and colorways in the right column.

ingredient.name: T-Digit Badge
ingredient.role: Carry the symbol and a contained area of magenta together.
ingredient.application: Use as a secondary mark; consult the Brand team for the limited-use text lockup.
ingredient.scope: Partnerships, apparel, merchandise and environments; the text lockup serves special recognition needs.
